required_stages.description: Single element-wise pass: z = x*gate + bias and out = z*sigmoid(z) (any equivalent algebraic form) in fp32, stored into a freshly allocated fp32 output; no intermediate, one launch.

forbidden_substitutions.message: library SiLU replaces the whole activation
host-side tensor arithmetic performs the fused multiply-add
extra buffer; only the fp32 output allocation is permitted

outputs.aliasing: none; a freshly allocated fp32 tensor of x's shape on every call

timing_boundary.notes: The timed run() contains the shape check, no-op .contiguous() calls, the fp32 output allocation and one launch. No casts, copies or packing of inputs; no state across calls.
